Kids Bible Class · May — Week 5

The Story of the Lost Sheep

Luke 15:1-7

“There will be great joy in heaven when even one lost person comes home to God.”

based on Luke 15:7 (NIrV)

God cares about every single one of us.

Image 1

Crowds of people loved to gather around Jesus and listen to Him. Even people who had made big mistakes wanted to be near Him.

Some of the religious leaders grumbled. “Why does Jesus spend time with people like that?” they said.

So Jesus told them a story to help everyone understand how much God loves them…

Image 2

“Imagine a shepherd who has one hundred sheep,” Jesus said. The shepherd took care of them all day long.

Every evening he counted them to make sure each one was safe: “…ninety-seven, ninety-eight, ninety-nine…”

Oh no! One little sheep was missing! Where could it be?

Image 3

Now, the shepherd still had ninety-nine other sheep — but that did not matter. That one lost sheep was so special to him that he had to go and find it.

He made sure the ninety-nine were safe, then climbed over the hills and searched the rocky places, calling out for his little sheep.

It was getting dark, but he would not give up. He kept looking and looking until he found it.

Image 4

At last — there it was! The shepherd found his little lost sheep.

He wasn't angry at all. He was so happy and full of joy!

Gently, he lifted the sheep up onto his shoulders and carried it safely all the way home.

Image 5

When he got home, the shepherd called all his friends and neighbors together. “Be happy with me!” he said. “I found my lost sheep!”

Then Jesus said that God is just like that shepherd. God looks for every single one of us. And when even one person comes home to Him, all of heaven is filled with joy!

God cares about every single one of us.

What We Learn

Jesus is like the good shepherd. He loves every single person, and He goes looking for anyone who is lost or far away. When even one person comes back to Him, all of heaven throws a party!

For you: You matter so much to God. If you ever feel lost, alone, or far away, remember — Jesus is always looking for you, and He is so happy when you are close to Him.
